sets.subject: English
sets.passage_en: Urban trees do much more than decorate a city. Their leaves _____ (1) _____ shade that lowers street temperatures. They also _____ (2) _____ dust and pollutants from the air, which _____ (3) _____ respiratory health. During heavy rain, roots _____ (4) _____ water into the ground and reduce flooding. For these reasons, city planners now treat trees as _____ (5) _____ infrastructure rather than a luxury.
sets.passage_hi: शहरी पेड़ शहर को सजाने से कहीं अधिक करते हैं। उनकी पत्तियाँ ऐसी छाया _____ (1) _____ करती हैं जो सड़क का तापमान कम करती है। वे हवा से धूल और प्रदूषक भी _____ (2) _____ करते हैं, जिससे श्वसन स्वास्थ्य _____ (3) _____ होता है। तेज़ बारिश में जड़ें पानी को ज़मीन में _____ (4) _____ करती हैं और बाढ़ कम करती हैं। इन कारणों से शहर के योजनाकार अब पेड़ों को विलासिता नहीं, बल्कि _____ (5) _____ अवसंरचना मानते हैं।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge cloze passage on urban trees and heat; not an SSC passage.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the word closest in meaning to "benevolent".
questions.text_hi: "benevolent" के अर्थ के सबसे निकट शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: "Benevolent" means kind and wishing to do good, so "kind" is the closest synonym.
questions.solution_hi: "Benevolent" का अर्थ है दयालु और भला चाहने वाला, इसलिए "kind" सबसे निकट समानार्थी है।
questions.trick_en: Link benevolent to "benefit" — wishing good for others.
questions.trick_hi: Benevolent को "benefit" से जोड़ें — दूसरों का भला चाहना।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to "expand".
questions.text_hi: "expand" के अर्थ के सबसे विपरीत शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: "Expand" means to become larger; "contract" means to become smaller.
questions.solution_hi: "Expand" का अर्थ है बड़ा होना; "contract" का अर्थ है छोटा होना।
questions.trick_en: Pair the word with its physical opposite: balloon expands, metal contracts.
questions.trick_hi: भौतिक विपरीत से जोड़ें: गुब्बारा फैलता, धातु सिकुड़ती है।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct spelling of the noun meaning 'an event that happens'.
questions.text_hi: 'घटित होने वाली घटना' के अर्थ वाले संज्ञा शब्द की सही वर्तनी चुनें।
questions.solution_en: "Occurrence" has double "c", double "r" and ends in "-ence".
questions.solution_hi: "Occurrence" में दोहरा "c", दोहरा "r" और अंत में "-ence" है।
questions.trick_en: Remember: o-cc-u-rr-ence.
questions.trick_hi: याद रखें: o-cc-u-rr-ence।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: What does "once in a blue moon" mean?
questions.text_hi: "once in a blue moon" का क्या अर्थ है?
questions.solution_en: The idiom means something that happens very rarely.
questions.solution_hi: यह मुहावरा उस बात के लिए है जो बहुत कम होती है।
questions.trick_en: Think of the rarity of a blue moon.
questions.trick_hi: नीले चाँद की दुर्लभता सोचें।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: One word for "a person who loves and collects books":
questions.text_hi: "पुस्तकों से प्रेम करने और संग्रह करने वाले व्यक्ति" के लिए एक शब्द:
questions.solution_en: A bibliophile loves books; a philatelist collects stamps and a numismatist collects coins.
questions.solution_hi: Bibliophile को किताबों से प्रेम होता है; philatelist टिकट और numismatist सिक्के संग्रह करता है।
questions.trick_en: Biblio- means book.
questions.trick_hi: Biblio- का अर्थ पुस्तक है।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: One word for "an abnormal fear of water":
questions.text_hi: "पानी के प्रति असामान्य भय" के लिए एक शब्द:
questions.solution_en: Hydrophobia is fear of water; claustrophobia is fear of closed spaces, acrophobia of heights and xenophobia of strangers.
questions.solution_hi: Hydrophobia पानी का भय है; claustrophobia बंद स्थान, acrophobia ऊँचाई और xenophobia अजनबियों का भय है।
questions.trick_en: Hydro = water; phobia = fear.
questions.trick_hi: Hydro = पानी; phobia = भय।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the word closest in meaning to "candid".
questions.text_hi: "candid" के अर्थ के सबसे निकट शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: "Candid" means honest and direct, so "frank" fits best.
questions.solution_hi: "Candid" का अर्थ है ईमानदार और स्पष्ट, इसलिए "frank" सबसे उपयुक्त है।
questions.trick_en: A candid answer is a frank answer.
questions.trick_hi: Candid उत्तर का अर्थ स्पष्ट और सच्चा उत्तर है।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Find the error: Each of the boys (A) / have submitted (B) / their assignments (C) / No error (D).
questions.text_hi: त्रुटि चुनें: Each of the boys (A) / have submitted (B) / their assignments (C) / No error (D)।
questions.solution_en: "Each" is singular, so the verb should be "has submitted", not "have submitted".
questions.solution_hi: "Each" एकवचन है, इसलिए क्रिया "has submitted" होनी चाहिए, "have submitted" नहीं।
questions.trick_en: Words like each, every and either take a singular verb.
questions.trick_hi: each, every, either के साथ एकवचन क्रिया आती है।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Find the error: He is senior (A) / than me (B) / by five years (C) / No error (D).
questions.text_hi: त्रुटि चुनें: He is senior (A) / than me (B) / by five years (C) / No error (D)।
questions.solution_en: Latin comparatives such as senior, junior, superior and inferior take "to", not "than": "senior to me".
questions.solution_hi: senior, junior, superior, inferior जैसे तुलनात्मक शब्दों के साथ "than" नहीं, "to" आता है: "senior to me"।
questions.trick_en: Senior/junior/superior/inferior always take "to".
questions.trick_hi: Senior/junior/superior/inferior के साथ सदैव "to"।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: She is very good ___ mathematics.
questions.text_hi: वह गणित में बहुत अच्छी है। (रिक्त स्थान भरें)
questions.solution_en: The correct collocation is "good at" a subject or skill.
questions.solution_hi: सही संयोजन "good at" है, किसी विषय या कौशल के लिए।
questions.trick_en: Good at skills; good for health.
questions.trick_hi: कौशल के लिए good at; स्वास्थ्य के लिए good for।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: It took me ___ hour to finish the report.
questions.text_hi: रिपोर्ट पूरी करने में मुझे ___ घंटा लगा।
questions.solution_en: "Hour" begins with a vowel sound, so the indefinite article is "an".
questions.solution_hi: "Hour" का उच्चारण स्वर से शुरू होता है, इसलिए अनिश्चित उपपद "an" आता है।
questions.trick_en: Choose the article by sound, not by the first letter.
questions.trick_hi: उपपद पहले अक्षर से नहीं, उच्चारण से चुनें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: He ___ in this company since 2019.
questions.text_hi: वह 2019 से इस कंपनी में ___ है।
questions.solution_en: "Since 2019" marks an action continuing to the present, which needs the present perfect continuous.
questions.solution_hi: "Since 2019" वर्तमान तक जारी क्रिया दर्शाता है, जिसके लिए present perfect continuous आता है।
questions.trick_en: Since/for with an ongoing action → has/have been + -ing.
questions.trick_hi: since/for के साथ जारी क्रिया → has/have been + -ing।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the best improvement: The committee will discuss about the proposal tomorrow.
questions.text_hi: सर्वोत्तम सुधार चुनें: The committee will discuss about the proposal tomorrow.
questions.solution_en: "Discuss" is a transitive verb and takes a direct object; "about" is unnecessary.
questions.solution_hi: "Discuss" सकर्मक क्रिया है और सीधे कर्म लेती है; "about" अनावश्यक है।
questions.trick_en: Do not add a preposition after discuss, resemble or reach.
questions.trick_hi: discuss, resemble, reach के बाद उपसर्ग न जोड़ें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Change to passive voice: They are building a new bridge.
questions.text_hi: कर्मवाच्य में बदलें: They are building a new bridge.

options.en: A new bridge is being built.
options.hi: A new bridge is being built.

options.en: A new bridge was being built.
options.hi: A new bridge was being built.

questions.solution_en: Present continuous passive is "is/are being + past participle": a new bridge is being built.
questions.solution_hi: वर्तमान अपूर्ण कर्मवाच्य "is/are being + past participle" है: a new bridge is being built।
questions.trick_en: Continuous passive always includes "being".
questions.trick_hi: अपूर्ण कर्मवाच्य में सदैव "being" आता है।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct indirect speech: She said, "Where do you live?"
questions.text_hi: सही अप्रत्यक्ष कथन चुनें: She said, "Where do you live?"

options.en: She asked where did I live.
options.hi: She asked where did I live.

options.en: She asked where do I live.
options.hi: She asked where do I live.

questions.solution_en: A reported wh-question uses statement order with a shifted tense: "She asked where I lived."
questions.solution_hi: अप्रत्यक्ष wh-प्रश्न में कथन क्रम और बदला हुआ काल आता है: "She asked where I lived."
questions.trick_en: In reported questions, do not keep the question word order.
questions.trick_hi: अप्रत्यक्ष प्रश्न में प्रश्नवाचक शब्द-क्रम न रखें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct passive form of "Someone has stolen my bag."
questions.text_hi: "Someone has stolen my bag." का सही कर्मवाच्य रूप चुनें।

options.en: My bag was stolen by someone has.
options.hi: My bag was stolen by someone has.

questions.solution_en: Present perfect passive is "has/have been + past participle": my bag has been stolen.
questions.solution_hi: वर्तमान पूर्ण कर्मवाच्य "has/have been + past participle" है: my bag has been stolen।
questions.trick_en: Perfect passive = has/have been + V3.
questions.trick_hi: पूर्ण कर्मवाच्य = has/have been + V3।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Rearrange: P. the scientist Q. patiently R. recorded S. the readings
questions.text_hi: पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: P. the scientist Q. patiently R. recorded S. the readings
questions.solution_en: Subject "the scientist", adverb "patiently", verb "recorded", object "the readings" gives P Q R S.
questions.solution_hi: कर्ता "the scientist", क्रिया विशेषण "patiently", क्रिया "recorded", कर्म "the readings" से P Q R S बनता है।
questions.trick_en: Subject → adverb → verb → object.
questions.trick_hi: कर्ता → क्रिया विशेषण → क्रिया → कर्म।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Rearrange: P. although it was raining Q. the match R. continued S. without a break
questions.text_hi: पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: P. although it was raining Q. the match R. continued S. without a break
questions.solution_en: The concessive clause "although it was raining" comes first, then subject, verb and adverbial: P Q R S.
questions.solution_hi: रियायती उपवाक्य "although it was raining" पहले, फिर कर्ता, क्रिया और क्रिया विशेषण: P Q R S।
questions.trick_en: A clause beginning with although/because generally fronts the sentence.
questions.trick_hi: although/because वाला उपवाक्य सामान्यतः वाक्य के आरंभ में आता है।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.sub_topic: Shuffling of sentences in a passage
questions.text_en: Arrange: S. The village had no bridge. Q. During the monsoon the river rose. P. Children could not reach school. R. The panchayat finally built a footbridge.
questions.text_hi: व्यवस्थित करें: S. The village had no bridge. Q. During the monsoon the river rose. P. Children could not reach school. R. The panchayat finally built a footbridge.
questions.solution_en: The missing bridge (S) is the setting, the rising river (Q) creates the problem, school absence (P) is the effect and the footbridge (R) is the solution: S Q P R.
questions.solution_hi: पुल न होना (S) पृष्ठभूमि है, नदी का बढ़ना (Q) समस्या, स्कूल न जा पाना (P) प्रभाव और पैदल पुल (R) समाधान: S Q P R।
questions.trick_en: Setting → problem → effect → solution.
questions.trick_hi: पृष्ठभूमि → समस्या → प्रभाव → समाधान।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.sub_topic: Shuffling of sentences in a passage
questions.text_en: Arrange: P. The results were announced. Q. She had prepared for months. R. Her name was on the list. S. She celebrated with her family.
questions.text_hi: व्यवस्थित करें: P. The results were announced. Q. She had prepared for months. R. Her name was on the list. S. She celebrated with her family.
questions.solution_en: Preparation (Q) precedes the announcement (P), followed by the result (R) and celebration (S): Q P R S.
questions.solution_hi: तैयारी (Q) पहले, फिर घोषणा (P), परिणाम (R) और उत्सव (S): Q P R S।
questions.trick_en: Flashback preparation comes before the main event.
questions.trick_hi: पूर्व तैयारी मुख्य घटना से पहले आती है।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the most appropriate word for blank (1).
questions.text_hi: रिक्त स्थान (1) के लिए सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: Leaves provide shade; the other verbs do not collocate with shade here.
questions.solution_hi: पत्तियाँ छाया प्रदान करती हैं; अन्य क्रियाएँ यहाँ छाया के साथ उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।
questions.trick_en: Read the whole sentence; the surrounding words decide the collocation.
questions.trick_hi: पूरा वाक्य पढ़ें; आसपास के शब्द संयोजन तय करते हैं।
